propositions: code-review verdicts assembled by code_review_coach and finalize_code_review_verdict never set provider_provenance, leaving the field absent in every signed verdict

provider_provenance must be threaded from the Pass-2 verify agent step (whose outputs are the runner result verbatim) through to the terminal verdict assembly, mirroring the fix applied to plan-review and completion gates in story 343b
the degraded/outage code-review verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than deriving it from config, to avoid synthesizing a record that did not drive any actual run
provider_provenance must not be recomputed at the verdict site, as capabilities.provenance_for's docstring forbids recomputation that could diverge from the record that actually drove the run
code-review.yaml must wire provider_provenance from an AGENT step only, never from a scripted op, so the outputs are the runner result verbatim
